example_request: curl -sG "https://sky.esa.int/esasky-tap/tap/sync" --data-urlencode "REQUEST=doQuery" --data-urlencode "LANG=ADQL" --data-urlencode "FORMAT=json" --data-urlencode "QUERY=SELECT table_name FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE table_name='tap_schema.tables'"
resolution_notes: base_url: ORIGINAL is correct. ESA's current TAP+ home page identifies https://sky.esa.int/esasky-tap/tap as the service root and exposes sync and tables beneath it: https://sky.esa.int/esasky-tap/tap . example: corrected conservatively to query mandatory TAP_SCHEMA metadata instead of assuming ivoa.obscore; ESA documents ADQL table discovery and SELECT queries at https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/esdc/esasky-interface and TAP sync parameters at https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia-users/archive/programmatic-access .
